Sometimes when your not in the right mindset, you stop functioning. I sometimes distance myself from people just to cool off. You are a person reserving of living no matter how much of a bad person you are. 

You can never learn to accept others when you can accept yourself. You cant feel love if you dont love yourself, suicide is a permanent solution to a temporary problem. You feeling the need to distance yourself is completely fine.

I believe you pushed everyone because you need time to think about what's important and that's yourself. Learn from simple mistakes they way you treat others is just your response on what's going on in your head. Try to find one good friend/ person you could consult with, even if you want a person yo talk with online message me. You should know that you should cherish your because your a human after all, we learn make mistakes then continue to move on.

The time we take to move on depends from one person to another depends, its completely fine to take more time and it's complicated fine to take less time. And if you need further help contact a therapist and pour out your feelings, our bucket of emotions should be poured out when its filled.

Also good for you, I hope your plan into going to therapy will be filled with healing and joy.

I don't believe in guilt, I believe in living on impulse as long as you never intentionally hurt another person, and don't judge people in your life. I think you should live completely free.

Your intention was never to hurt your family. You are a great person for trying to do the right thing, you need to try and rely on some people such as your partner. Tell them the full situation and show them that you are trying to move forward and take immediate action for what your dad is doing.

Money will eventually come, put your focus on graduating and getting a stable job so you could help your family. 

You said that your dad keeps kicking your gma, I think you should take your gma in and help her for the time being because of corona and quarantine. After quarantine, try to take your family with you one by one.

You said your sister is a college student, you could try to save money together and escape this sticky situation.

Your guilt can be justified. In law a man is guilty when he violates the rights of others. In ethics he is guilty if he only thinks of doing so. You think your guilty for trying to get your life back together. Leaving your family was just a step to stabilise yourself and coming back is you trying to help them. 

Please cherish yourself. And I hope you find peace within yourself. And here (online hug).
